name: Webhook
description: Receives inbound webhook payloads from external services and ingests them as data records. Supports HMAC signature verification for payload authenticity.
author: OnePlatform

webhookPath.title: Webhook Path
webhookPath.description: The path segment for receiving webhooks, e.g. 'my-webhook'. External services POST to /api/v1/ingestion/webhooks/{connectorId}.

signatureHeader.title: Signature Header
signatureHeader.description: The HTTP header containing the HMAC signature, e.g. 'X-Hub-Signature-256'. Required when signature verification is enabled.

signatureAlgorithm.title: Signature Algorithm
signatureAlgorithm.description: The HMAC algorithm used to compute payload signatures. sha256 is strongly preferred; sha1 is provided for legacy compatibility only.

idField.title: ID Field
idField.description: A dot-notation path to a field in the webhook payload to use as the record's sourceId. When absent, the platform-assigned webhook payload ID is used.

batchSize.title: Batch Size
batchSize.description: Maximum number of queued webhook payloads to process per fetchBatch call.

requiredCredentials.name: signatureSecret
requiredCredentials.description: HMAC secret used to verify webhook payload signatures. The ingestion service uses this to authenticate incoming payloads. Leave unconfigured to skip signature verification.
